Name: Jehu, Son of Josibiah
Summary: Son of Josibiah son of Seraiah son of Asiel, prince of Simeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:35: Son of Josibiah son of Seraiah son of Asiel, prince of Simeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehu stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
